opening.argument: The presentation promotes a paid-entry giveaway built around a StrongBlock node, Ethereum, and projected passive income. The speaker says, "It pays you passive income in the form of about .1 strong per day or about $25 a day," while also stating that "it cost about $2500 dollars to start this node." He directs viewers to a Patreon page and explicitly links monthly payments to additional chances: "three dollars five dollars in eight dollars this will be one entry two entries and three entries." Those paid tiers use the prospect of valuable node income to encourage participation. The evidence does not establish that a winner received the prize or that anyone realized the promised returns, so the claim rests on the paid promotion and promised opportunity rather than a demonstrated payout.
